title: World History Timeline - Decade by Decade
author: SenseForMaps

axis.calibration: century labels -3100..2000 at x=60..2002; fit over the printed axis label blobs and the full-height 38.08 px grid
axis.decade_alignment: every 10 years = 3.808 px, so each bar edge resolves to about ±2 years; values are snapped to the decade grid

method: pixel-calibrated raster extraction; band rows transcribed from 3x zoomed tiles with a coordinate frame, fill runs re-derived from the raster

coverage.note: The poster was cut into 15 horizontal bands x 4 columns. 'partial' bands are missing their right-hand column (x 1625-2032), so recent dates in those bands stop early. 'missing' bands have no transcription at all and their entities are absent, not empty.

i18n.note: English is what the poster prints. zh-CN is a translation of those strings keyed by the exact English text; a missing key falls back to English in every output.

caveats: The 2048 px raster is far smaller than the original poster; text below ~6 px is only partly legible and is marked with '?' or missing.
Bands whose label is unreadable are named after their longest printed span.
Language-family assignment is a nearest-colour match against the printed colour key; adjacent shades of the same hue can be ambiguous.
Rows that straddle a tile boundary were stitched by label + geometry; a few may be duplicated or split.
